title: Oromia Bank invites sealed bids from eligible bidders for the procurement of Electric Vehicles.
summary: Oromia Bank S.C. is inviting sealed bids for the procurement of electric vehicles. The bid closing date is 16 November 2026 at 15:00, with opening at 15:30 the same day. Bidders must submit bid documents and pay a 1,000 Birr document fee. The tender is a direct vehicle purchase opportunity, with no additional terms disclosed.

title: Sidama Bank invites all interested and eligible bidders for the supply of vehicles.
summary: Sidama Bank S.C. is inviting bids for the supply of vehicles, likely for its fleet expansion. The bid closing date is 12 November 2026 at 14:00, with opening at 14:30. Bidders must submit a bid bond of 200,000 Birr and a bid document fee of 400 Birr. The tender does not specify a budget, but the bank expects competitive pricing and compliance with its procurement guidelines.

summary: Debre Markos Specialized Hospital invites bids for the supply of printing materials, office supplies, cleaning items, vehicle tires, vehicle lubricants, and vehicle spare parts. summary: The Oromia Land Bureau invites competitive bids from legal garages to provide maintenance services for its office vehicles. The tender requires bidders to submit documents by November 11, 2026, at 13:00, with bid opening scheduled for 14:30 the same day. A bid bond of 150,000 ETB is mandatory, and the bid document costs 200 ETB. This procurement specifically targets vehicle repair and garage services, aligning with the vehicle maintenance category.

title: EthSwitch Share Company invites this bid for interested and eligible bidders for the procurement of the Electric Minibus Vehicles
summary: EthSwitch Share Company invites bids for the procurement of Electric Minibus Vehicles. The bid closing date is November 3, 2026, at 10:30 AM, with bid opening at 10:45 AM on the same day. Interested bidders must purchase the bid document for 300.00 Birr and provide a bid bond of 500,000.00 Birr. This tender specifically targets the acquisition of electric minibuses, aligning directly with vehicle purchase criteria.
